summaries.zh: Infoseek is an end-to-end content intelligence & research workflow skill bundle for DeepSeek Harness. From an industry / topic / person / company seed it runs a reusable pipeline: multi-source sniffing → four-dimension relevance scoring gate (credibility, topical consistency, engagement depth, LLM-readability) → four-level deep-fetch degradation (static / rendered / credentialed / multimedia) → keyed-fact-slot contradiction detection → cross-source fusion → structured Markdown report with option
